objective: Build the missing robot motor-driver hardware foundation from a DC source through DC link, half bridge, gate loop, current sense, protection, thermal path and PCB evidence, then reconstruct TI TIDA-010956 without confusing a title claim with a measured operating point.

request_interpretation.curriculum_intent: Continue the bottom-up robotics dependency graph after motor drive and FOC, closing the hardware assumptions hidden behind commanded voltage and measured phase current.
request_interpretation.content_intent: Use a private compound inverter failure to force energy, commutation, gate, parasitic, loss, thermal, sensing, protection and bring-up coverage without publishing the problem as article prose.
request_interpretation.visual_intent: A Viz improvement must change representation, hierarchy, spacing, observability or interaction. A palette swap is not accepted.
request_interpretation.reference_intent: Treat a company reference design with the same provenance discipline as a paper: reconstruct its question, architecture, measurements, assumptions and unsupported extrapolations.
request_interpretation.formula_intent: Every display equation must include a short Korean operation reason inside KaTeX and exactly one unit, assumption and failure note below it.
request_interpretation.small_model_intent: Preserve the narrowing decisions so a 4B model can repair one claim/formula/Viz packet and a 9B model can assemble one causal section without inventing electrical evidence.

existing_coverage: robot-dynamics-feedback-control produces a bounded torque request
robot-embedded-realtime-control proves the command reaches the PWM latch on time
robot-motor-drive-foc maps torque through dq current, voltage, modulation and current observation
paper-blaschke-field-orientation-1973 establishes the historical coordinate-control principle
gap_audit.scope_boundary: The milestone teaches a low-voltage robot inverter and evidence workflow. It does not certify an isolated high-voltage drive, creepage and clearance, EMC compliance, regenerative brake sizing, functional safety or STO. Those remain a separate hardware-safety foundation.

source_decisions.source: Texas Instruments TIDA-010956 product page and Rev. B design guide
used_for: schematic, PCB, waveform and thermal evidence
source_decisions.boundary: The public thermal point is 48 V, 16 kHz, 26.2 Arms or 37 A peak, 28 C ambient, with no heatsink or fan. It does not prove 85 Arms continuous thermal operation, lifetime, arbitrary enclosure behavior or certified STO.

source_decisions.source: TI SLVAF66, Best Practices for Board Layout of Motor Drivers
source_decisions.boundary: Application guidance supplies mechanisms and layout heuristics, not a validated stack-up or current rating for the reader's board.

source_decisions.source: TI SLVA959B, Best Practices for Board Layout of Motor Drivers
source_decisions.boundary: Reference layouts cannot be copied without the target package, layer stack, copper weight, assembly and thermal boundary conditions.
Data-sheet limits must be checked at the selected supply, gate charge, PWM frequency, temperature and protection mode; feature presence does not establish system safety.
PWM rejection does not remove Kelvin, input-filter, layout, bandwidth, output swing, ADC aperture or settling requirements.

source_decisions.source: TI SDAA145A, DC-Link Capacitor Precharge Circuit
source_decisions.boundary: The example topology is not a universal hot-plug, discharge, welding-detection or regenerative-energy solution.

source_decisions.source: Infineon, PCB Layout Guidelines for MOSFET Gate Driver Applications
source_decisions.boundary: The mechanisms transfer, but numeric placement and impedance targets remain device, package and stack-up specific.
Amplifier guidance cannot prove end-to-end ADC accuracy or closed-loop current fidelity without target timing and calibration evidence.

private_transfer_gate.scenario: A 48 V robot joint uses a large DC-link capacitor without bounded precharge, accepts regenerative current into a source that cannot absorb it, commutates a half bridge with incomplete dead-time reasoning, selects a MOSFET from Rds(on) alone, drives it through a long shared-source gate loop, probes the switch node with a large ground loop, estimates only conduction loss, infers junction temperature from an unqualified surface point, routes shunt and power current together, samples before the amplifier settles, relies on firmware after a desaturation event and jumps directly to full-current bring-up.
required_insights: draw the complete energy and return path before choosing parts
separate source current, DC-link ripple current, phase current and regenerative current
derive precharge current, time and resistor energy
identify every half-bridge commutation and freewheel path
treat dead time as both shoot-through prevention and voltage distortion
derive gate-current and switching-edge tradeoffs from charge rather than nominal resistance
separate gate loop, power loop and measurement loop inductance
distinguish real switch-node ringing from probe-loop pickup
budget conduction, switching, gate, dead-time and passive losses
propagate loss through transient and steady thermal impedances
bind current-sense accuracy to shunt, Kelvin route, amplifier, PWM rejection, settling and ADC timing
budget independent fault detection, propagation and gate-discharge latency
convert shutdown latency into peak fault current and fault energy
read schematic, PCB, waveform and thermal evidence as one claim chain
commission from passive checks and current-limited power to bounded switching and load tests
keep title claim, shown test point, observation and extrapolation boundary separate
private_transfer_gate.publication_policy: Do not publish the integrated problem as a quiz. Map every premise to causal prose, a derivation, Korean-annotated formula, interactive state, evidence card or operational gate.

source_extraction.visual_review: Rendered guide, schematic and PCB pages were inspected where block boundaries, loop geometry, waveform conditions and thermal annotations could not be trusted from extracted text alone.
source_extraction.evidence_boundary: The TIDA title/design claim is 85 Arms. The shown public thermal result is a bounded 26.2 Arms operating point. The reconstruction preserves both values and forbids interpolation from the second to the first.

events.inference: Company research and reference documents should enter the same reconstruction pipeline when they provide primary implementation evidence.

implementation_decisions: Follow the energy path before introducing component names.
Treat the DC link as an energy buffer with inrush and regeneration contracts, not as an ideal voltage source.
Teach half-bridge current paths before PWM abstractions.
Derive switching speed from gate charge and current while exposing Miller and bootstrap limits.
Separate power loop, gate loop, Kelvin sense loop and probe loop geometrically.
Treat loss as an operating-point budget and temperature as a boundary-conditioned thermal network.
Treat current sensing as a timed analog chain, not an ADC register read.
Convert protection latency into physical current and energy before discussing firmware recovery.
Read company reference designs through claim, condition, observation and exclusion fields.
Use short Korean reasons inside every display equation and one detailed FormulaNote per equation.
Use dedicated mobile compositions when a desktop topology cannot remain readable by scaling.
Defer ambient animation until static causal states, controls and responsive evidence pass.

forbidden_shortcuts: generate both full articles in one pass
let a title claim stand in for a measured result
silently change electrical units or operating conditions
accept a palette swap as a Viz repair
accept zero overflow when formula scale is below threshold
claim safety certification from a shutdown feature

rejected_alternatives: Putting all power-electronics detail into the FOC article, which would hide a distinct hardware ownership boundary.
Using a generic academic converter paper while ignoring the richer schematic-PCB-waveform-thermal reference evidence.
Presenting the TIDA 85 Arms title beside the 26.2 Arms thermal result as if they were the same test.
Solving mobile formulas only with smaller fonts or horizontal scrolling.
Scaling the desktop TIDA architecture SVG until it technically fit on mobile.
Adding ambient animation before the static evidence states were legible and measurable.
remaining_risks: The labs are deterministic educational models, not oscilloscope, thermal-camera, dynamometer, conducted-emissions or fault-injection measurements from a physical inverter.
The formulas use declared first-order approximations and must not be used as a substitute for device data-sheet integration or SPICE and hardware validation.
High-voltage isolation, creepage, clearance, brake chopper and dump resistor sizing, EMC qualification, PL or SIL allocation and certified STO remain out of scope.
Continuous animation remains optional and should be added only when time evolution contributes information beyond explicit controls.
next_phase: Build the next robot hardware-safety dependency: isolation and auxiliary gate power, regenerative braking and discharge, creepage and clearance, EMC paths, independent torque shutdown and evidence needed before a power stage can become a production robot drive.
